name: Netmend AskVideo
title: Chat with any YouTube video: summary, timestamps and answers
desc: Paste a YouTube link, get a summary, key points with timestamps, and ask questions about the video. Free in your browser with your own Gemini key. No sign-up.
h1: Chat with any YouTube video, skip the watching
intro: Paste a public YouTube link. Netmend AskVideo gives you a summary, the key moments with timestamps, and answers to your questions about what was said and shown. Or paste a transcript from any video platform.
